name: Fish Segmentation (Focus-Aware)
description: Locates fish using a transformer-based instance segmentation model with two classes that separate in-focus from out-of-focus fish.

name: Apoidea Segmentation (Focus-Aware)
description: Locates bees, wasps, and related Apoidea species using a transformer-based instance segmentation model with two classes that separate in-focus from out-of-focus individuals.
